// ConnectionStrings: Read by AddConnectionString("meetingrooms-db") in AppHost.cs. Defaults to LocalDB, which needs no setup on a Windows dev machine. Override in user secrets to point at a different local SQL Server instance, e.g. dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:meetingrooms-db" "Server=.\SQLEXPRESS;Database=MeetingRooms;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True"
